fichas.title: Fire protection classification and resistance designations
fichas.summary: Overview of fire-protection requirements under the model and state building regulations and classification under DIN 4102 and DIN EN 13501. Tables relate fire-resistance durations and component types to designation codes, and classify building materials by fire behaviour. Essential-part definitions and test-related notes are included.
uses: Classify building components and materials by fire behaviour
Verify use of regulated and non-regulated building products
